    df_print: paged

Panel B of the merged IncN / IncL/M distance figure. Panel A is produced by
`Fig4A_IncN.Rmd`. The layout parameters and the species palette below must stay
identical in both files, otherwise the two panels will not match when merged.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(grid)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

# Layout parameters

`cell_mm` is the cell edge at **final printed size**. Place the exported PDF at
100 % scale when merging. Scaling it in the layout program shrinks the labels
below the size set here and breaks the match with panel A.

`label_pt` must stay below about 0.85 x cell size in points. 1 mm = 2.845 pt.

```{r params}
cell_mm   <- 2.8   # must match Fig4A_IncN.Rmd
label_pt  <- 7     # must match Fig4A_IncN.Rmd
legend_pt <- 10    # must match Fig4A_IncN.Rmd

dend_mm   <- 12    # row dendrogram
anno_mm   <- 3     # species strip
names_mm  <- 8     # isolate tick labels
slack_mm  <- 4
legend_mm <- 26    # vertical space for legends below the panel
letter_mm <- 7     # vertical space for the panel letter

cell_pt <- cell_mm * 2.845
if (label_pt > 0.85 * cell_pt) {
  warning(sprintf("label_pt = %.1f exceeds 0.85 x cell (%.1f pt).",
                  label_pt, 0.85 * cell_pt))
}
```

# Input

```{r input}
input_file <- "inclm_plasmids_distances_with_species.tsv"
```

# Species palette

Union of the species present in the IncN and IncL/M datasets, so colours are
consistent across panels and either legend can serve the merged figure.

```{r palette}
species_cols <- c(
  "C. freundii"   = "#66c2a5",
  "E. coli"       = "#fc8d62",
  "K. aerogenes"  = "#8da0cb",
  "K. pneumoniae" = "#e78ac3",
  "E. cloacae"    = "#a6d854",
  "K. oxytoca"    = "#ffd92f",
  "H. alvei"      = "#80b1d3",
  "S. marcescens" = "#c2a36b"
)
```

# Label parsing

This TSV encodes species in square brackets, unlike the IncN file. Isolate 7077
is assigned *S. marcescens*, which is a correction applied downstream of the
typing step.

```{r parsers}
make_short_label <- function(x) str_match(x, "isolate_([0-9]+)")[, 2]

extract_species <- function(x) {
  s <- str_match(x, "\\[([^\\[\\]]*)\\]$")[, 2]
  s[s == "Unknown"] <- NA_character_
  n <- str_match(x, "isolate_([0-9]+)")[, 2]
  s[n == "7077"] <- "S. marcescens"
  s
}
```

# Build matrix

```{r build}
dist <- read_tsv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

required_cols <- c("plasmid_1_labeled", "plasmid_2_labeled", "distance")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(dist))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

dist <- dist %>%
  mutate(
    s1  = make_short_label(plasmid_1_labeled),
    s2  = make_short_label(plasmid_2_labeled),
    sp1 = extract_species(plasmid_1_labeled),
    sp2 = extract_species(plasmid_2_labeled)
  )

all_labels <- sort(unique(c(dist$s1, dist$s2)))

mat_long <- dist %>% select(row = s1, col = s2, distance)

mat_sym <- bind_rows(
  mat_long,
  mat_long %>% rename(row = col, col = row),
  tibble(row = all_labels, col = all_labels, distance = 0)
) %>%
  distinct(row, col, .keep_all = TRUE)

mat <- mat_sym %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = distance) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(mat) <- mat$row
mat$row <- NULL
mat <- as.matrix(mat)[all_labels, all_labels]

if (any(is.na(mat))) {
  stop("Distance matrix contains missing pairwise comparisons. Do not impute.")
}

species_vec <- bind_rows(
  dist %>% transmute(short = s1, species = sp1),
  dist %>% transmute(short = s2, species = sp2)
) %>%
  distinct(short, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(short %in% rownames(mat)) %>%
  arrange(match(short, rownames(mat)))

unknown <- setdiff(na.omit(unique(species_vec$species)), names(species_cols))
if (length(unknown) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Species not in palette:", paste(unknown, collapse = ", ")))
}

species_vec <- setNames(species_vec$species, species_vec$short)
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
cat("Panel B:", nrow(mat), "IncL/M plasmids\n")

table(species_vec, useNA = "ifany")
```

# Colour scale

Capped at the 95th percentile of the off-diagonal distances. Panel A has its own
range, so state in the caption of the merged figure that the scales are
panel-specific. `colorRamp2` clamps out-of-range values, so the plotted matrix
needs no separate capping.

```{r scale}
max_break <- as.numeric(quantile(mat[upper.tri(mat)], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE))
cat("Colour scale 0 -", round(max_break, 2), "\n")

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  seq(0, max_break, length.out = 3),
  c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b")
)
```

# Heatmap

Column tick labels and the column dendrogram are dropped. The matrix is
symmetric and the same tree is used on both axes, so they duplicate the row side
and cost height.

```{r heatmap}
tree <- hclust(as.dist(mat), method = "average")
n <- nrow(mat)

anno_args <- list(
  species = species_vec,
  col = list(species = species_cols),
  simple_anno_size = unit(anno_mm, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  na_col = "#ffffff",
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    species = list(
      title = "Species",
      nrow = 2,
      grid_height = unit(3.5, "mm"),
      grid_width = unit(3.5, "mm"),
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = legend_pt),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = legend_pt, fontface = "italic")
    )
  )
)

# Set show_legend = FALSE here if panel A carries the shared species key.
ra <- do.call(rowAnnotation, c(anno_args, list(show_legend = TRUE)))
ca <- do.call(columnAnnotation, c(anno_args, list(show_legend = FALSE)))

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "IncLM",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = tree,
  cluster_columns = tree,
  row_dend_reorder = FALSE,
  column_dend_reorder = FALSE,
  row_split = 4,
  column_split = 4,
  row_title = NULL,
  column_title = NULL,
  row_gap = unit(0.6, "mm"),
  column_gap = unit(0.6, "mm"),
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = label_pt),
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  row_dend_width = unit(dend_mm, "mm"),
  left_annotation = ra,
  top_annotation = ca,
  width = unit(n * cell_mm, "mm"),
  height = unit(n * cell_mm, "mm"),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = NA),
  border = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "DCJ-indel distance",
    direction = "horizontal",
    legend_width = unit(35, "mm"),
    title_position = "topleft",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = legend_pt),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = legend_pt)
  )
)
```

# Export

```{r export}
mm_to_in <- function(x) x / 25.4

page_w <- dend_mm + anno_mm + n * cell_mm + names_mm + slack_mm
page_h <- letter_mm + anno_mm + n * cell_mm + legend_mm

cat(sprintf("Panel B: body %.0f mm, page %.0f x %.0f mm\n",
            n * cell_mm, page_w, page_h))

render <- function() {
  grid.newpage()
  pushViewport(viewport(
    x = unit(0, "npc"), y = unit(0, "npc"),
    width = unit(1, "npc"), height = unit(1, "npc") - unit(letter_mm, "mm"),
    just = c("left", "bottom")
  ))
  draw(ht, newpage = FALSE,
       heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
       annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
       merge_legend = TRUE,
       padding = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "mm"))
  popViewport()
  grid.text("B",
            x = unit(1.5, "mm"), y = unit(1, "npc") - unit(1.5, "mm"),
            just = c("left", "top"),
            gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))
}

pdf("Fig4B_IncLM_DCJ_indel_heatmap.pdf",
    width = mm_to_in(page_w), height = mm_to_in(page_h),
    useDingbats = FALSE)
render()
dev.off()

png("Fig4B_IncLM_DCJ_indel_heatmap.png",
    width = page_w, height = page_h, units = "mm", res = 600)
render()
dev.off()

render()
```
